title: Work with numbers
instructions_md:
## Numbers need no quotes

Python can calculate. Use `+` to add, `-` to subtract and `*` to multiply.

```python
boxes = 4
pens_in_box = 6
pens = boxes * pens_in_box
print(pens)
```

```text
24
```

## Your task

A library has `12` shelves. Each shelf holds `30` books. Store the numbers in `shelves` and `books_per_shelf`. Store the total in `books`, then print `books`.
hints: The total is one number multiplied by the other.
Set `shelves` and `books_per_shelf`, multiply them into `books`, then print `books`.
starter_code: # Store the numbers, calculate, then print.
solution_code:
shelves = 12
books_per_shelf = 30
books = shelves * books_per_shelf
print(books)

wrong_answers.label: adds instead of multiplying
wrong_answers.code:
shelves = 12
books_per_shelf = 30
books = shelves + books_per_shelf
print(books)

tests.name: `shelves`, `books_per_shelf` and `books` hold the numbers
tests.hint: Check the spelling of the three variable names.
